Apply for the beta

Plans announced at launch

Truscale plans and prices will be published at launch. Founding members keep a lower price for life.

What does the beta cost?

Nothing. The app is free for founding members during the private beta.

What price will I pay after the beta?

Beta members lock in a low founding price for life. The amount is announced with the plans at launch.

How do referral months work?

For every builder you refer who becomes a paying customer, you get one month free.
